text: Acquired-image derivative-chain isolation completed (intensity-chain-pilot-v1, source 9c223081759c599574ba1c1bab82fe39f24dc0e112979325b0ed207900e0c475). CC intensity-gradient dot actual warped-image changes passes the same 0.005 minimum symmetric relative error plus three-point decreasing-error criterion in every direction. Thus this checkpoint's gap is localized to the spatial/composition chain, rather than CC intensity-gradient algebra. Three tests each pass on JVM and Scala.js; original current loss is unchanged. No optimizer update rule or fresh qualification output changed. Source, protocol, all rows, checks, exact baseline replay and figure are archived in docs/benchmarks/evidence/halfflow-intensity-chain-20261014, with report docs/benchmarks/halfflow-intensity-chain-v1.md.
